proves.claim: snapshotWip writes staged, unstaged and untracked work to refs/pullboard/wip/<item> and leaves the folder's index bytes and mtime, HEAD and status unchanged

cli.io-item-wip.snapshot-keeps-builder-s.why: Without it a snapshot could disturb the builder's index or lose part of the work it is meant to keep safe.

proves.claim: a second snapshot of an unchanged folder writes no new commit, and none runs while index.lock exists

cli.io-item-wip.snapshot-skips.why: Without it the beater would pile up identical snapshots or race a builder's own git command.

proves.claim: openItemFolder makes a re-offered item's new folder start from refs/pullboard/wip/<item> when newer than the branch head, restored as uncommitted work with the branch head unchanged

cli.item-folder.reoffer-starts-from-wip.why: Without it a dead seat's uncommitted work is lost when the item is claimed again.

proves.claim: with no wip snapshot, or one not newer than the branch head, a re-offered item's new folder starts clean from the branch

cli.item-folder.reoffer-without-wip.why: Without it a stale snapshot could overwrite newer committed work.

proves.claim: one claim beater tick for a seat holding a claimed item calls snapshotWip, so refs/pullboard/wip/<item> holds the uncommitted change, and a failing snapshot never fails the tick

cli.io-beater.tick-snapshots-claimed-fol.why: Without it a seat that goes away loses its uncommitted work the board could have kept.

proves.claim: a board call the claiming seat makes through entry.js snapshots its claimed item folder at most once a minute per item, and a seat with no claim snapshots nothing

cli.io-beater.board-call-snapshots-claim.why: Without it a seat driven one command at a time, with no beater, never has its work saved.
